demand_sop.name: Plan (Demand Planning, Sensing & S&OP)
demand_sop.fullName: Pillar 1: Plan — Demand Planning, Sensing & S&OP (The Forecasters)
demand_sop.subtitle: Forecasts customer demand, senses market shifts, and aligns supply and sales in monthly S&OP.
demand_sop.coreQuestion: What, how much, when, and where will customers buy, and how do we align cross-functional capacity before spending capital?
demand_sop.systems: SAP IBP · Blue Yonder Demand · Anaplan · Vertex AI TimesFM · BigQuery · AlloyDB
demand_sop.solverSummary: Vertex AI TimesFM Foundation Model + BigQuery ML ARIMA-Plus + Optuna Hyperparameter Tuner + Bayesian Price Elasticity Solver + Gemini 3.1 Pro Multi-Agent Consensus Synthesizer
demand_sop.toilMetric: 4 weeks of manual Excel rollups per S&OP cycle
toilBullets: Planners burn 40+ hours per month chasing sales reps and marketing for offline promotional spreadsheets with conflicting numbers
Statistical baseline models fail to capture real-time weather shocks, social sentiment, macro inflation, and localized demand swings
Executive S&OP meetings debate whose numbers are correct rather than evaluating pre-computed, P&L-optimized scenario choices
impactBullets: Autonomous ingestion and reconciliation of 40+ external demand signals in BigQuery, slashing forecast WAPE by 28%
Multi-agent S&OP scenario simulation evaluates Revenue, Margin, Service Level, and Working Capital trade-offs in 45 minutes
Dynamic promotional lift modeling isolates cannibalization and halo effects, saving $14M annually in misallocated trade spend
demand_sop.kpis: Forecast Accuracy / WAPE | S&OP Cycle Time | Bias % | Promo ROI

sourcing_procurement.name: Source (Strategic Sourcing & Category Procurement)
sourcing_procurement.fullName: Pillar 2: Source — Strategic Sourcing & Category Procurement (The Buyers)
sourcing_procurement.subtitle: Manages supplier selection, cost modeling, contract compliance, and multi-tier supply risk.
sourcing_procurement.coreQuestion: Who do we buy from at what cost, under what geopolitical and ESG risks, and how do we ensure component availability across Tier-N suppliers?
sourcing_procurement.systems: SAP Ariba · Coupa · Cloud Spanner Graph · AlloyDB + pgvector · Dun & Bradstreet · Resilinc
sourcing_procurement.solverSummary: Parametric Should-Cost Bottom-Up Breakdown Engine + Cloud Spanner Graph N-Tier Lineage Tracer + LLM Contract Clause Extractor (Gemini 3.1 Pro) + Supplier Risk Multi-Criteria Classifier
sourcing_procurement.toilMetric: 6 weeks of manual RFQ negotiation & blind Tier-N risk
toilBullets: Buyers negotiate blind without bottom-up material should-cost models, overpaying suppliers 8–15% on custom fabricated parts
Zero visibility past Tier-1 suppliers leaves companies blindsided when a single Tier-3 resin or chip supplier halts global production
Contract compliance, ESG audits, and certificate of analysis (COA) verification require weeks of manual document review
impactBullets: Real-time parametric should-cost models dynamically recalculate fair prices against live raw material indices (LME, ICIS, energy)
Graph neural network on Cloud Spanner maps 4 tiers of supplier dependencies, identifying single-source bottlenecks before disruptions strike
Autonomous RFQ drafting, negotiation agent, and clause compliance verification reduce contracting cycle time by 72%
sourcing_procurement.kpis: Purchase Price Variance (PPV) | Sourcing Cycle Time | Supplier OTIF % | Tier-N Risk Score

manufacturing_prod.name: Make (Production Planning & Manufacturing / MPS)
manufacturing_prod.fullName: Pillar 3: Make — Production Planning & Manufacturing / MPS (The Makers)
manufacturing_prod.subtitle: Schedules factory production lines, monitors equipment health (OEE), and ensures inline quality.
manufacturing_prod.coreQuestion: How do we manufacture the right products on the right lines at maximum OEE, minimal scrap, and zero unplanned downtime?
manufacturing_prod.systems: Siemens Opcenter · Rockwell FactoryTalk · SAP PP/MES · BigQuery ML · Vertex AI AutoML
manufacturing_prod.solverSummary: OR-Tools CP-SAT Finite Capacity Job Shop Scheduler + Vibration Spectral Predictive Maintenance (BigQuery ML) + Gemini 3.8 Flash Vision Inline QA Inspector + BOM Delta Topology Engine
manufacturing_prod.toilMetric: 18 hours of daily rescheduling & reactive machine downtime
toilBullets: Production schedulers spend hours manually reshuffling line schedules on spreadsheets whenever emergency orders or breakdowns occur
Unplanned machine breakdowns cost up to $260K/hour because maintenance teams react to failures rather than predicting bearing wear
Inline scrap and defect root-cause analysis is performed days after production runs, leaving thousands of defective units produced
impactBullets: Constraint Programming (OR-Tools CP-SAT) sequences jobs in <30 seconds, minimizing changeovers, cleanings, and energy peaks
Edge vibration and acoustic telemetry analysis predicts spindle/bearing failures 72 hours early, preventing line stoppages
Gemini 3.8 Flash multimodal vision performs sub-second inline defect classification, triggering automated diverter gates
manufacturing_prod.kpis: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) | Schedule Adherence % | Scrap Rate % | First Pass Yield (FPY)

inventory_warehouse.name: Fulfill (Inventory, MEIO & Warehousing)
inventory_warehouse.fullName: Pillar 4: Fulfill — Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization & 3D Warehousing (The Buffers & Custodians)
inventory_warehouse.subtitle: Optimizes inventory buffers across hubs, automates 3D warehouse slotting, and manages dock operations.
inventory_warehouse.horizon: Tactical Horizon (Weekly) to Real-Time Daily Execution
inventory_warehouse.coreQuestion: Where should inventory be buffered across the multi-echelon network, how do we promise orders in <50ms, and how do we run dock-to-stock in <4 hours?
inventory_warehouse.systems: SAP IBP MEIO · Blue Yonder WMS · Manhattan Active · Cloud Spanner · Google OR-Tools · BigQuery
inventory_warehouse.solverSummary: Clark-Scarf Multi-Echelon Stochastic Safety Stock Solver + Sub-50ms Spanner Strict Quota ATP Engine + 3D Golden-Zone High-Bay AS/RS Slotting IP + Google Maps Fleet Engine Dock Door Demurrage Shield
inventory_warehouse.toilMetric: Trapped capital in wrong nodes & 14-hour dock-to-stock delays
toilBullets: Each warehouse node buffers inventory independently, causing severe bullwhip magnification and $85M+ in trapped working capital
Order promising takes hours of batch ATP runs, causing overselling, emergency stockouts, and cancelled high-margin customer orders
Manual 2D warehouse slotting forces pickers to walk 12+ miles/shift, while inbound trailers queue in yards causing massive demurrage
impactBullets: Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization (MEIO) mathematically places decoupling buffers at central plants, freeing 24.8% working capital
Sub-50ms real-time ATP on Cloud Spanner commits inventory across DCs with strategic quota reservation for Tier-1 accounts
Dynamic 3D Golden-Zone slotting cuts picker travel time by 32%, and automated dock yard geofencing eliminates trailer demurrage
inventory_warehouse.kpis: Days Inventory Outstanding (DIO) | Order Promise Latency (ms) | Dock-to-Stock Time (hrs) | Warehouse Pick Rate (lines/hr)

logistics_fleet.horizon: Real-Time Multi-Modal Daily Execution & Secondary Distribution
logistics_fleet.coreQuestion: How do we transport freight across Ocean, Air, Rail, and Road with maximum cube fill, zero demurrage, and execute secondary distribution to retail counters?

logistics_fleet.toilMetric: 22% multi-modal freight waste & field stockout pitches

Gemini 3.8 Flash multimodal vision audits retail shelf photos for planogram compliance, automating verified trade scheme payouts

circular_enable.name: Return & Enable (Customer OTIF, Circular RMA & ESG)
circular_enable.fullName: Pillar 6: Return & Enable — Customer OTIF Defense, Circular RMA & Scope-3 ESG (The Guardians)
circular_enable.subtitle: Protects on-time customer delivery (OTIF), automates returns (RMA), and tracks Scope 3 emissions.
circular_enable.coreQuestion: How do we recover value from damaged/expired returns, defend against retailer chargebacks, and govern Scope-3 carbon & supply risks?
circular_enable.systems: SAP Claims & Returns · Retail OTIF Portals · Loop RMA · Google Earth Engine · ISO-14083 Carbon Engine · BigQuery Omni
circular_enable.solverSummary: Retail OTIF Deduction Dispute Classifier + Gemini 3.8 Flash Edge RMA Grading + Google Maps Fleet Backhaul CVRPTW + ISO-14083 GEE Carbon Ledger
circular_enable.toilMetric: 3.5% revenue lost to OTIF fines & unrecovered returns
toilBullets: Retailer On-Time In-Full (OTIF) penalty deductions and shortage chargebacks are absorbed without automated dispute evidence
Customer returns ship via costly third-party LTL to central depots while outbound fleet trucks return backhaul empty
Shipment-level Scope-3 carbon accounting (CBAM/EUDR) and enterprise supply chain risk assessments rely on static annual guesswork
impactBullets: Predicts retailer OTIF breaches 72 hours early to reallocate stock and auto-generates contract-backed dispute dossiers with digital PODs
Multimodal edge RMA grading and Google Maps fleet backhaul insertion recover Grade-A stock locally, boosting margin by 31%
Automated ISO-14083 compliant shipment-level Scope-3 carbon ledger provides verified audit trails for global regulatory reporting
circular_enable.kpis: OTIF Fine Deduction ($) | Return Processing Cycle (days) | Scope-3 Carbon Intensity (gCO2e/t-km) | Net Return Recovery %

demand_planning_dir.name: Demand Planning Director
demand_planning_dir.role: Global Forecast Accuracy (WAPE / Bias) & Consensus Demand
demand_planning_dir.summary: Owns enterprise demand forecasting across all product families, channels, and distribution hubs—bridging real-time consumption signals with replenishment commitments.

dayInLife.before: Debates subjective sales forecast overrides without historical accuracy tracking, allowing systematic upward bias.

sop_ibp_lead.name: S&OP / IBP Process Lead
sop_ibp_lead.summary: Orchestrates the monthly and weekly S&OP cycle—reconciling commercial demand against plant capacity, supplier constraints, working capital, and gross margin targets.

dayInLife.before: Waits 3 days for FP&A to translate unit volume shifts into gross margin and cash-flow impact.
dayInLife.after: Real-time P&L, COGS, and inventory cash-flow translation updates live as scenario sliders move.

dayInLife.activity: Chairs the executive S&OP review with CSCO and CFO, locking trade-off decisions live on screen.
Commits approved supply envelopes directly into ERP production schedules and MEIO inventory targets.

promo_launch_planner.name: Demand Shaping & Launch Manager
promo_launch_planner.role: Promotional Lift, Price Elasticity & New Product Launches (NPI)
promo_launch_planner.summary: Models causal demand drivers—promotions, pricing actions, and New Product Introductions—to shape demand toward available high-margin supply and prevent bullwhip spikes.

dayInLife.before: Discovers factory or stock shortages only after a major commercial promotion has already gone live.
dayInLife.after: Cross-checks real-time MEIO stock buffers and recommends high-margin substitute SKUs with surplus capacity.

dayInLife.activity: Locks the monthly demand-shaping calendar with Sales and Marketing leadership.

meio_inventory_mgr.name: Global Inventory (MEIO) Manager
meio_inventory_mgr.role: Multi-Echelon Safety Stocks, Working Capital & Rebalancing
meio_inventory_mgr.summary: Optimizes inventory buffers across plants, central distribution centers, and regional fulfillment hubs to maximize service fill rates with minimal trapped cash.

dayInLife.before: Identifies aging or obsolete inventory lots only during quarter-end financial write-offs.
dayInLife.after: Predicts SLOB risk 60 days ahead and pairs with Demand Shaping to clear stock profitably.

dayInLife.activity: Reviews network cash-release trajectory and service-level trade-offs with Supply Chain and Finance leads.

warehouse_slotting_lead.role: 3D DC Slotting, Pick-Wave Execution & Labor Productivity
warehouse_slotting_lead.summary: Directs distribution center execution—governing 3D rack slotting, order wave release, automated shuttle/forklift routing, and outbound dock staging.

dayInLife.before: Diagnoses conveyor and forklift bottlenecks reactively after aisles gridlock mid-shift.
dayInLife.after: Live 3D CAD heatmap predicts aisle congestion 30 minutes ahead and re-sequences wave releases automatically.

dayInLife.activity: Verifies outbound staging lanes are aligned with Fleet Dispatch truck arrival sequences.

atp_fulfillment_spec.role: Real-Time Available-to-Promise, Split Prevention & Factory/DC/Mode Arbitrage
atp_fulfillment_spec.summary: Governs global order promising across factories, regional DCs, and transit modes (Ocean, Air, Rail, Truck)—ensuring customer SLAs are met without split shipments or margin erosion.

dayInLife.activity: Reviews daily corridor cost-per-ton-km and fleet utilization trends with transportation leadership.

dayInLife.after: Computes exact 3D Center-of-Gravity, CMVR/DOT front/rear axle weight ratios, and IATA ULD contour compliance before loading.

dayInLife.before: Ships multiple half-empty Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) or LCL ocean consignments along identical regional corridors.

stages.after: Classifies returns via multimodal vision into Grade-A immediate restock, refurbish, or supplier warranty claim.
stages.goldenThread: Routes Grade-A stock into regional ATP pools and defect data into Stage 06.

stages.name: Supplier Defect Chargeback & Circular Margin Ledger
stages.before: Field return write-offs are absorbed because RMA defect codes are never linked back to supplier lot warranties.
stages.after: Links field RMA spikes to supplier production lots, triggers 8D CAPAs, and posts automated warranty debit memos.
stages.goldenThread: Updates net recoverable inventory in EchelonFlow MEIO and PromiseGuard ATP.
